Team —

Quick heads-up: finance asked for a reconciled R/Y/G rundown for all Q2 commit deals by EOD Tuesday so they can finalize the quarter close sensitivity. Attached is the reconciliation sheet (Q2_RYG_reconciliation_v3.xlsx) — I populated the base rows with CRM stage + last touch. Ask list: 

- Owners: update Stage and Commit % in the sheet (column H/I) by EOD Tuesday.
- Flags: mark deals as Red / Yellow / Green and add 1-line save plan for any Red/Yellow.
- Evidence: paste the latest procurement / legal blockers in column K and drop links to any outstanding PO or SOW in column L.

Notes: Finance wants a conservative view — if you are at 60% confidence and there is an outstanding PO with procurement, mark Yellow and add the expected PO date. If there is a hard blocker (contract redline unresolved or SOC request), mark Red.

I looped in Marissa for forecasting alignment; we'll aggregate into the runbook and share with FP&A. cc'ing Julie at Acme in the next message once we have a consolidated R/Y/G.

Thanks — please reply in-thread with any changes you make so I can capture timestamps.

Naomi Feldman
Senior RevOps Manager

- Sean: Draft a one-page save-plan for Nimbus (pilot-based demo + timeline), drop in Drive and flag the sheet link.
- Marissa: I'll need your headcount + forecast delta note for ClearWave pricing swing (column M).

3) External loop: I'll send a neutral consolidation email to Julie Park <julie@acme.com> after Marcus confirms legal owner/date — language will be focused on transparency, not pressure. Draft will be shared here for quick sign-off.

4) Deliverable for FP&A: consolidated sheet + 1-page save-plans for each Red/Yellow by 04/20 12:00 PT.

If anything blocks you from hitting these dates, reply with the blocker and I will reassign or escalate.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
